{{Quote|Markez Moon. Neen Valley. Station Four junction. We leave tomorrow night.|Saw Gerrera feeding false intel to Pluti|<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />}}
'''Neen Valley''' was a valley on [[Markez Moon]]. The [[Station Four]] junction of the [[Markez Moon pipeline]] ran through the valley.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> 

In [[3 BBY]]<ref name="GhormanDate">"[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" dates the events of "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]" to [[3 BBY]].</ref> [[Saw Gerrera]] fed false intel to a mole working for the [[Galactic Empire]] within his [[Partisans|rebel cell]] by telling the mole, [[Pluti]], that the group was going to execute a [[Rhydonium heist]] at the Station Four junction in the valley.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" />

==Behind the scenes==
Neen Valley was first mentioned in "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]," the fifth episode of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
